identity.worldRole: The readable baseline test unit that exposes whether the player's route, damage and defensive hypotheses actually work.
identity.manufactureContext: A recurring expedition threat shaped by the hostile world rather than a player-like soldier, built for mass readability and fair telegraphing.
identity.emotionalIntent: Slightly unsettling, forceful and occasionally absurd, but never visually deceptive or gore-dependent.
identity.territoryVisualThesis: A compressed scavenger threat whose forward wedge, heavy adapted limb and unstable shell history oppose the fortress's calm competence while remaining bold enough for horde readability.

instantRead.oneSecondPromise: This compact forward-heavy creature advances toward the fortress, threatens structures, and clearly shows when it is weakened.
instantRead.orientationCue: A forward wedge, visor or head aperture leads the compressed torso; the rear closes into a service-like dorsal mass.
instantRead.interactionCue: No friendly interaction socket is present; readable target zones must not resemble repair affordances.
instantRead.dangerCue: Forward posture, heavy hands and threat accents communicate intent before attack effects begin.
instantRead.relationToPlayer: Hostile but fair test instrument whose telegraphs allow preparation, reaction and post-failure understanding.

proportionRules: The torso and shoulder mass dominate over limbs.
Hands are oversized enough to communicate structural threat at distance.
Legs remain short and planted so the silhouette cannot be confused with a player avatar.
The forward wedge remains inside the two-and-a-half-stud width.

views.front: A compressed non-human threat with broad shoulder mass, heavy hands and a clear forward visor or wedge.
views.back: A closed dorsal mass and narrower rear silhouette separate retreat direction from the active threat face.
views.left: The forward lean, compact legs and heavy leading arm reveal attack intent without animation.
views.right: The counter-profile preserves forward weight while approved asymmetry may shift armor or one heavy hand.
views.top: A tapered forward footprint points toward the target and avoids a player-like shoulder rectangle.
views.bottom: Two grounded feet and compact leg connections remain simple and robust for animation and mobile visibility.
views.threeQuarterFront: The canonical read combines forward wedge, heavy hands, compressed torso and fortress-facing momentum.
views.threeQuarterBack: The dorsal mass and rear taper remain readable without adding decorative appendages.
views.gameCamera: In a horde, each unit remains one forward-driving threat token with clear state posture and no thin-limb noise.

plausibilityRules: Every visible part belongs to a named component and has a functional relationship to at least one neighboring component.

construction.stableNamingRule: Component IDs and gameplay anchors never change without an approved canon revision.

artDirection.territoryThesis: A hopeful fortress culture of intelligent survival: calm standardized chassis make every tool dependable, while one or two visible adaptations turn scarcity, repair and shared history into proud authorship without post-apocalyptic noise.
shapeGrammar: large protected apertures and explicit load-bearing joints
one localized offset brace or replacement module
visible replacement, reinforcement, sealing or rerouting logic
artDirection.exaggeration: Function, load paths, service access and the single authored adaptation are enlarged enough to read on mobile; distress, dirt and tiny mechanics never carry identity.
artDirection.edgeLanguage: Large consistent structural bevels create calm readable highlights; only the boundary of an approved repair may use a sharper cut or visibly renewed edge, and nothing becomes razor-thin.
artDirection.detailDensity: Low secondary construction density and extremely low tertiary density; seventy-two percent primary mass, twenty-three percent functional secondary structure and five percent causal finish.
artDirection.asymmetry: Twenty-four-percent controlled asymmetry expresses adaptation inside a seventy-five-to-eighty-five-percent standardized chassis; footprint, facing, collision promise, pivots and gameplay anchors remain fixed.
artDirection.materialLanguage: Deep coated structure, reclaimed composite panels, exposed durable metal, matte contacts and rare contextual wood surround carefully protected interaction technology.
artDirection.paletteLogic: Deep slate and bone-sand create a quiet frontier base; sun-baked copper identifies player intervention, while mint interaction, raspberry threat, gold warning and red critical remain bounded semantic roles.
artDirection.surfaceTreatment: Broad calm planes, one or two patch boundaries and directional abrasion tell a construction history without uniform grime, material roulette or photoreal texture chatter.
artDirection.wearLogic: Every scar must name a cause: prior impact, heat, hand contact, ground abrasion or an approved repair operation; damage widens one causal chain and repair reverses it.

forbidden: decorative repair with no causal reason
